name: Quick Share
author: jhannesreimann
description: Send and receive files, links and text with Android phones over Google Quick Share. No pairing, and fast Wi-Fi transfers even when the phone is on another network. Builds its background service from source with one click (needs Rust). Optional for laptops with one Wi-Fi card: a small Wi-Fi helper that runs as root, installed to /usr with a polkit rule that lets your session run it without a password.
